name: Suka Laser Tower
desc:
Who likes to play towers with lots of red lasers? 😝
🎮 Let's play SUKA LASER TOWER! The red laser is a one-kill weapon that creates excitement hehehe. 
There are 4 different routes with different difficulty levels:
🔹 Normal Trail - Suitable for beginners 
🧒 Bocil Trail - More easy and relaxed 
👴 Sepuh Trail - A serious challenge for experienced players 
🔒 Secret Path - A hidden path with unique challenges 
Each path has different difficulty levels and many shortcuts for those who are skilled and willing to take risks.
Test your reflexes, patience, and parkour skills in SUKA LASER TOWER! 🔴⚡
